controls.detail: The simulator reports a brightness value but has no writable physical backlight.
This device has no rear torch.
Use the native volume panel. iOS does not provide a general writable system volume property.
Choose an available output in the system route picker.
The native route picker chooses compatible audio/video destinations for the app; it does not enable system screen mirroring.
Low Power Mode is observed from iOS. Change it in the system Settings app.

snapshot.detail: Public UIKit device integrations. Contacts respect the selected access scope; message composition reports the actual system composer outcome. Device controls reflect observed hardware and permissions.

roles.detail: The running device/build does not have an eligible signed Default Dialer entitlement. The standard calling handoff remains available.
Carrier messaging requires the signed entitlement, an eligible iPhone/region and selection as default. The normal message composer remains separate.

end.liveness_source: Shell kill -0 of its direct simctl launch child; not native application liveness.

cleanup.boundary: The artifact measures kill -0 of the direct simctl launch driver. It does not independently prove native application termination or simulator deletion: inherited cleanup suppresses simctl terminate/shutdown/delete failures.
cleanup.xctest_launch_driver_wait_basis: The XCTest artifact reports TEST EXECUTE SUCCEEDED, and the shell reaches its final passed phase only after a successful wait for the owned xcodebuild launch child. This is distinct from the direct simctl console-driver kill -0 records.

local_reverification: Passed unchanged verify-ios-smoke.py for all seven sequential snapshots using original Start baseline and each exact URI; additionally each warm snapshot timestamp follows its request. Unchanged verify-ios-devices.py passed real provider evidence.

runtime_build.source: Smoke uses steps.bundle.outputs.app, produced by the optional carrier build after the standard build.
runtime_build.qualification: Simulator evidence does not qualify entitled physical-device carrier operations.

authorization_summary.interpretation: This attempt records Prompt in the first captured ready Start observation, the real provider report and every warm snapshot. It does not capture an initial Unknown state; earlier preserved attempts do. Prompt is authorization status, not a displayed location modal.

bootstrap_timing.basis: The first URL request is written only after the shell observes phase=ready. Its timestamp bounds readiness observation from above; it is not the exact time the test published ready. All times use runner UTC logs.

runtime_startup_observations.boundary: These records show prolonged simulator boot/migration and system-app readiness before the app and XCTest phases. The lower-level reason for the simulator delay is unproven; XCTest readiness itself completed within both the previous 120-second and current 240-second allowance.
